item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Slack integration for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent will support Slack in private preview. Teams can mention the agent in Slack channels to start or continue incident investigations in the place where responders already coordinate.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol support in Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent adds public preview support for the open Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. This lets SRE agents delegate tasks to other agents and receive tasks from them while preserving each team’s permissions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Agent 365 for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 in public preview. This lets security and IT teams view and govern SRE agents alongside other organizational agents, with each agent able to have its own Agent ID.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Teams integration for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Teams integration in public preview. Engineers can start investigations and interact with the agent in Teams chats, channels, and meeting chats without leaving the app.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Native AWS and Google Cloud support in Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now has built-in connectors for AWS and Google Cloud in public preview. This lets users investigate applications and dependencies across Azure and connected cloud environments from one place.

  • Source: Azure Updates
